text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Fourth Middle East International Quality Conference is due to start on Sunday.
- Federal Express opened a new "gateway" facility at Bahrain International Airport to expand its operations in Bahrain.
- Trade volume between Bahrain and Singapore increased in 1996 to $22.8 million from $19 million a year earlier.
- Bahrain International Airport was rated one of the best in the Middle East and Europe in the latest international passenger survey by a leading British market research organisation.
- National Insurance Company posted 11,000 dinars net profit in 1996.
- The Shura council is to discuss on Tuesday whether United Arab Emirates' nationals may own real estate in Bahrain.
